method.method_draft: Assign heavy-atom degrees from the image. The substituted benzene ring contributes degree sum 13 for its six carbons: the six ring bonds give 12 degree counts, plus the substituent bond adds 1. The imine carbon has degree 2, N has degree 2, the N-adjacent carbon has degree 2, and the right-hand acetal carbon has degree 3. The two O atoms each connect to the acetal carbon and an ethyl carbon, contributing 4 total. The two ethyl groups contribute 4 from the two O-adjacent ethyl carbons and 2 from the two terminal ethyl carbons. Total heavy-atom degree sum = 13 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 4 + 2 = 32, so bonds = 32/2 = 16.
